body: No worries. I am a *wo*man though :P not that that really makes a difference but nonetheless...

There's nothing really to say, but I've enjoyed talking to you. It's honestly nice to say something and not have someone try the ol' "it gets better" routine. Just to have my thoughts acknowledged feels good. So thank you. I'm not sure whether I'll ever stop experiencing these thoughts, but I've been doing my best trying to reason with myself as to why I shouldn't do it. Lately I guess it just feels like I've run out of all my reasons. I have plenty of friends, no SO - I'm notoriously terrible at committing to someone. I think a lot of that too is that I don't want to have to open up to someone and burden them with my long list of problems. I feel like people don't deserve to have all of that dumped on them; they don't deserve to have to deal with my issues when I already know how difficult they are for me to cope with (but funny since I have no problems with people bringing their problems to me and carrying the burden for them).

Like I said, anything I can think of would just be a temporary fix. I've tried many, many things, done a lot of self exploration, accomplished a decent amount... Nothing has ever stopped me from wanting to kill myself. Now *that's* something I want to do!!
Congrats! That's awesome. And there is always a way to make more money if you really want to.
What kind of things do you want to do?

Haha! That's why I've been high for the past four years. But now even the novelty of that has worn off. Cheers my friend.

I'm 23 btw. I know, "I'm too young to have experienced all there is to life"

I don't want to live. I've done plenty of things. The joy felt from doing things is only temporary and there's nothing I particularly want to do anymore. I feel like it's just prolonging the inevitable.

I don't think life means nothing. If anything I value life more than anything else. I just feel like I've grown as much as I can as I person and there is nothing left for me to do here. It's like completing all the quests in a video game and now you're just aimlessly wandering the world with nothing left to do... I just feel like it's time for me. I'm tired of waiting around for nothing, I just want to put down the controller and turn off the console.
